name: Colorful Wish ~12ko no Maji★kyun!~
original_name: カラフルウィッシュ～12コのマジ★キュン！～
source:
A world where magic commonly exists. Children who have a special ability enter boarding magic school. The ability usually appears only to girls, but it appears to Riku. He joins the school and somehow lives a peaceful life with female students. 

School festival is hold every winter and there is magic competition. It seems the winner is given a special present from the school principal. He and his classmates get together and practice hard to win the competition.

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
这是一个魔法普遍存在的世界。拥有特殊能力的孩子会进入寄宿制魔法学校。这种能力通常只会出现在女孩身上，陆却也拥有它。他进入学校，与女学生们过起了不知为何十分平静的生活。

学校每年冬天都会举办学园祭，其中设有魔法竞赛。据说获胜者能够得到校长赠予的特别礼物。陆与同班同学齐心协力，为赢得比赛而刻苦练习。

[摘自ErogeShop]
